metadata.name: cot_core
metadata.description: Crypto of Thrones core program: reward vault, signed claim vouchers, fee split and referrals for the game token

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

errors.name: VoucherTtlOutOfBounds

errors.name: Paused

errors.msg: Order sequence must be strictly greater than the last paid order
